Name: Chicken Products Expansion
Author: BILI23wzxw1229
Description: 1.Blue chickens can lay blue eggs and large blue eggs. You can use them to produce blue mayonnaise.2.The mod edits the mayonnaise machine that can use brown eggs(Including large brown eggs) to produce brown mayonnaise.3.The mod edits golden chicken and void chicken that can lay large golden,void eggs.4.Ostrich eggs can make ostrich mayonnaise.

Manifest.Name: (CP) Chicken Products Expansion
